g.text: The evaluated bound and its exact original-path asymptotics
These curves describe lower-bound formulas, not measured spectral masses
Points evaluate the full formulas at 180 decimal digits; segments connect those samples only.
d₀ = 3200π²/κ*; C₄ = 532082. All boundary terms remain in the finite-j formulas [LPF7].
